tips.title: Legs & Lungs Crusher
tips.markdown:
## Legs & Lungs Crusher
Stair sprinting meets lower body burn.
**Warm-Up** _(~5 min)_
- High knees — 30 sec
- Arm circles — 30 sec each direction
- Walking lunges — 10 each leg

**The Circuit** _(repeat 3 rounds)_
1. Stair sprints — 30 sec
2. Jump squats — 15 reps
3. Split stair squats — 12 each leg
4. Calf raises — 20 reps
5. Stair bear crawls — 30 sec

**Finisher**
- Broad jumps up the stairs — 10 reps

**Cool-Down**
- Seated forward fold stretch — 1 min

_Friday Stairs is a community workout, not medical advice. Check with a doc before starting anything new._

tips.title: Core & Climb
tips.markdown:
## Core & Climb
Engage the core with every step.
**Warm-Up** _(~5 min)_
- Jumping jacks — 1 min
- Torso twists — 30 sec each side
- Walking leg swings — 10 each leg

**The Circuit** _(repeat 3 rounds)_
1. Plank on stairs — 1 min
2. Reverse lunges on stairs — 12 each leg
3. Incline mountain climbers — 30 sec
4. Russian twists with feet on a step — 20 each side
5. Stair climbers (hands on bottom step) — 30 sec

**Finisher**
- Flutter kicks with legs elevated (on a step) — 1 min

**Cool-Down**
- Standing hamstring stretch — 1 min

_Friday Stairs is a community workout, not medical advice. Check with a doc before starting anything new._

tips.title: Speed Intervals
tips.markdown:
## Speed Intervals
Quick bursts, max heart rate.
**Warm-Up** _(~5 min)_
- Butt kicks — 1 min
- Arm swings — 30 sec each direction
- Forward leg swings — 10 each leg

**The Circuit** _(repeat 5 rounds)_
1. Sprint up stairs — 30 sec
2. Jog down — recover
3. Incline push-ups — 10 reps
4. Stair walking lunges — 10 each leg
5. Stair hops (two steps at a time) — 10 reps

**Finisher**
- Stair skips — 1 min

**Cool-Down**
- Quad stretch on the spot — 1 min each leg

_Friday Stairs is a community workout, not medical advice. Check with a doc before starting anything new._

tips.title: Full-Body Burner
tips.markdown:
## Full-Body Burner
Hit everything—head to toe.
**Warm-Up** _(~5 min)_
- Side shuffles — 1 min
- Shoulder rolls — 30 sec each direction
- Hip circles — 30 sec each direction

**The Circuit** _(repeat 3 rounds)_
1. Burpees on stairs — 10 reps
2. Tricep dips on steps — 15 reps
3. Step-ups with knee raise — 12 each leg
4. Stair plank walk (sideways) — 20 sec each direction
5. Box jumps — 10 reps

**Finisher**
- Stair plank hold — 1 min

**Cool-Down**
- Child’s pose on stairs — 1 min

_Friday Stairs is a community workout, not medical advice. Check with a doc before starting anything new._

tips.title: Upper-Body Push
tips.markdown:
## Upper-Body Push
Focus on chest, shoulders, and triceps.
**Warm-Up** _(~5 min)_
- Arm circles — 30 sec each direction
- Light jog on the spot — 1 min
- Shoulder taps — 20 reps

**The Circuit** _(repeat 3 rounds)_
1. Incline push-ups — 15 reps
2. Tricep dips on steps — 15 reps
3. Stair plank shoulder taps — 20 reps
4. Elevated pike push-ups — 10 reps
5. Stair crawl downs (backwards) — 20 sec down

**Finisher**
- Elevated plank to push-up position — 1 min

**Cool-Down**
- Cross-body shoulder stretch — 1 min each arm

_Friday Stairs is a community workout, not medical advice. Check with a doc before starting anything new._

tips.title: Glutes Galore
tips.markdown:
## Glutes Galore
Emphasize your power base.
**Warm-Up** _(~5 min)_
- Glute bridges — 15 reps
- Leg swings — 10 each leg
- High knee marches — 1 min

**The Circuit** _(repeat 3 rounds)_
1. Step-ups with kickback — 15 each leg
2. Stair squats — 15 reps
3. Lateral stair lunges — 12 each side
4. Donkey kicks (hands on step) — 15 each leg
5. Stair jump lunges — 10 reps

**Finisher**
- Stair squat hold — 1 min

**Cool-Down**
- Figure four stretch seated on step — 1 min each leg

_Friday Stairs is a community workout, not medical advice. Check with a doc before starting anything new._

tips.title: Endurance Grind
tips.markdown:
## Endurance Grind
Long haul for stamina and strength.
**Warm-Up** _(~5 min)_
- Skipping in place — 1 min
- Side lunges — 10 each side
- Arm swings — 30 sec each direction

**The Circuit** _(repeat 4 rounds)_
1. Jog up and down stairs — 2 min
2. Incline push-ups — 12 reps
3. High knees on the spot — 1 min
4. Walking lunges on flat — 15 each leg
5. Calf raises — 20 reps

**Finisher**
- Slow jog up and down — 2 min

**Cool-Down**
- Forward fold stretch — 1 min

_Friday Stairs is a community workout, not medical advice. Check with a doc before starting anything new._

tips.title: Beginner-Friendly Steps
tips.markdown:
## Beginner-Friendly Steps
Start here—no sweat worries.
**Warm-Up** _(~5 min)_
- Marching in place — 1 min
- Arm circles — 30 sec each direction
- Ankle rolls — 30 sec each

**The Circuit** _(repeat 3 rounds)_
1. Step-ups — 10 each leg
2. Incline knee push-ups — 10 reps
3. Stair knee raises — 10 each leg
4. Standing calf raises — 15 reps
5. Side steps on stairs — 10 each side

**Finisher**
- Fast feet on the spot — 30 sec

**Cool-Down**
- Standing quad stretch — 1 min each leg

_Friday Stairs is a community workout, not medical advice. Check with a doc before starting anything new._

tips.title: EMOM Sweat Fest
tips.markdown:
## EMOM Sweat Fest
Every Minute On the Minute challenge.
**Warm-Up** _(~5 min)_
- Light jog on spot — 1 min
- Arm circles — 30 sec each direction
- Leg swings — 10 each leg

**The Circuit** _(repeat 5 rounds)_
1. Stair sprints — 15 sec
2. Incline push-ups — 10 reps
3. Stair lunges — 10 each leg
4. Plank jacks — 15 reps
5. Rest — balance the minute

**Finisher**
- All-out stair sprint — 1 min

**Cool-Down**
- Pigeon pose stretch — 1 min each side

_Friday Stairs is a community workout, not medical advice. Check with a doc before starting anything new._

tips.title: Descending Ladder
tips.markdown:
## Descending Ladder
Reduce reps, increase intensity.
**Warm-Up** _(~5 min)_
- Arm swings — 30 sec each direction
- Butt kicks — 1 min
- Leg swings — 10 each leg

**The Circuit** _(complete ladder 5-4-3-2-1 reps)_
1. Burpees on stairs
2. Incline push-ups
3. Stair lunges (each leg)
4. Box jumps
5. Tricep dips

**Finisher**
- Plank on stairs — 1 min

**Cool-Down**
- Seated hamstring stretch — 1 min

_Friday Stairs is a community workout, not medical advice. Check with a doc before starting anything new._
